name: Stream-safe Music
author: Hails
description: For streaming and recording: plays music that streams and videos may use instead of the game's soundtrack, with each song's title and artist on screen. Turn it on in the launcher (Tools > Stream-safe mode), which downloads the music and writes CREDITS.txt for your stream or video description.

shuffle.label: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Play the songs in a random order.

volume.label: Volume
volume.description: The music's volume on the game's music level (1 = the same).
